sources.title: Dusty homepage (retained baseline)
sources.scope: Vendor homepage offer, not runtime proof
excerpts: Dusty is optimized for macOS 13 (Ventura) and newer, with full native support for both Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) and Intel Macs.

To generate an explanation, Dusty sends only a file's name, path, size, category, and modification date to Google's Gemini API. Paths can include your username and folder names, so skip AI explanations if that's a concern. Our website uses Google Analytics. The app itself collects no usage analytics.

sources.title: Features
sources.scope: Vendor documentation identifies v2.5.1; binary parity untested
excerpts: Dusty translates complex directory trees into a multi-ring polar sunburst. Rings reflect folder hierarchy levels, while angular sectors mirror exact byte footprints on your SSD.
Seamlessly restore your offloaded backup back to your Mac whenever you set up a new phone or sync with Finder.
Move multi-gigabyte iPhone backups to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, or an external SSD safely without corrupting device pairing.
Detects abandoned node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, IntelliJ caches, and Homebrew download archives across your system.
Dusty connects directly to Google Gemini 1.5 Flash to synthesize plain English explanations before you touch a single byte.
Nothing is permanently destroyed without your deliberate confirmation.

workflow.proposedTitle: Move or delete? Reviewing an iPhone backup before Mac cleanup
workflow.primaryIntent: Help a Mac owner distinguish preserving an old phone backup by offloading from deleting expendable generated files.
workflow.descriptionDirection: Start with preservation: determine whether a phone backup is still needed before treating its size as removable waste. Dusty documents offload/restore; this is not a tested restore tutorial.
sections: Keep the backup decision separate from the free-space goal
Documented Dusty offload and restore destinations, with unknown recovery behavior
Review destination capacity, backup copies, access and restoration needs before acting
Do not mistake Trash bytes or offloaded bytes for measured available space
Choose specialised offload or broader investigation based on the job

workflow.interactionPass: A non-destructive decision checklist: still need backup? independent copy? destination accessible? verified restore procedure? If any unknown, stop. No deletion commands, device data upload or claimed trial results.
